summary: Teredo lets nodes behind one or more IPv4 NATs obtain IPv6 connectivity by tunneling IPv6 packets over UDP. It relies on Teredo servers and relays; the servers are stateless and handle only a small fraction of the traffic. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: If you are stuck behind a door that only speaks the old language, Teredo wraps new-language messages in old-language envelopes so they can pass through.

questions: how to get ipv6 behind a nat
